Als eines der führenden E-Health-Unternehmen in Europa sind wir die Brücke zwischen Ärzten und Patienten. Unsere intelligente Softwarelösung bietet effiziente Ressourcenplanung und Online-Terminbuchung, unter höchster Datensicherheit. Durch unsere Arbeit unterstützen wir die Beziehungen zwischen allen Beteiligten im Gesundheitswesen, ermöglichen moderne digitale Behandlungsformen und verbessern dadurch die Gesundheitsversorgung deutlich. 
Wir wollen dazu beitragen, dass Menschen schneller gesund werden und alle einen einfachen und guten Zugang zu Gesundheitsbehandlungen bekommen. Wir etablieren digitale Gesundheitsservices.


Du hast Lust mit uns durchzustarten?

Sende uns deine Bewerbung mit deinem Lebenslauf und einem Nachweis deines höchsten Bildungsabschlusses direkt über den Bewerben-Button.
Was nach deiner Bewerbung auf dich wartet:    1. Erstgespräch mit Philipp    2. Case Study inkl. Rollenspiel mit unserem Sales Team    3. Cultural Add mit Alex
Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich bei uns zu bewerben! Wir bei samedi schätzen Leidenschaft, Engagement und den Willen, Neues zu lernen und wer weiß, vielleicht bist genau du die Verstärkung, die wir suchen. Da wir als Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen mit sensiblen (Patienten-)Daten arbeiten, legen wir großen Wert auf Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit. Das bedeutet, dass wir im Laufe des Bewerbungsprozesses eine Identitätsprüfung durchführen (bitte halte dafür deinen Personalausweis bereit) und dich bitten, uns dein Zeugnis des höchsten Bildungsabschlusses zukommen zu lassen. Keine Sorge, deine Noten sind uns dabei nicht wichtig. Uns geht es vor allem darum, dich als Person kennenzulernen und die formalen Anforderungen für unser Sicherheitskonzept zu erfüllen.

data.title: Senior Endpoint Engineer
data.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We're looking for a Sr Endpoint Engineer who's excited about consolidating and updating legacy systems with an eye for automation. You'll be responsible for the MDM platforms, endpoint policies, device deployment pipelines, and fleet tooling that underpin how every employee at Wave interacts with their device. This role blends architectural ownership with hands-on execution, requiring you to deliver scalable, resilient, and compliant endpoint solutions in a fast growth environment.

You'll own the endpoint function end-to-end: platform and policy design, provisioning standards, fleet reporting, and security integration. You'll work closely with Information Security, IT, and People Operations, and you'll be the person who sets the technical direction for how Wave manages devices at scale. The first year will be weighted toward remediation and foundation-building before shifting toward automation and scale. Candidates who have built in scrappy, high-complexity environments will be better prepared for this role than those who have only operated mature platforms in static environments.

In this role, you'll: 

  • Own and operate Wave's MDM platforms across ChromeOS (GWS Admin Console), macOS (Jamf), Android, (and Linux environments): configuration, policy design, maintenance, and roadmap.
    • Manage ChromeOS device policy in Google Workspace: enrollment configuration, org unit structure, security policies, extension management, and OS version enforcement across the majority of the fleet.
  • Design and enforce endpoint security policies in collaboration with Information Security, including EDR integration (CrowdStrike Falcon), compliance baselines, and patch management.
  • Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines for OS updates, software distribution, and configuration changes: minimizing manual intervention and maximizing consistency. 
  • Define and manage the device lifecycle: provisioning standards, imaging, refresh cycles, decommission processes, and fleet reporting.
  • Establish cross-platform compatibility standards and tooling for a heterogeneous fleet (macOS, Linux, Android, with awareness of ChromeOS and Windows edge cases).
  • Build the tooling and runbooks that Local IT teams use to execute provisioning and onboarding on the ground. You set the standard, they execute it.
  • Own fleet observability: dashboards, compliance reporting, patch currency metrics, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Evaluate and own vendor relationships for endpoint tooling, including MDM, patch management, and related platforms.
  • Mentor junior profiles working in endpoint and device management.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso. Wherever you are based, you must have reliable Internet access and have work authorization.
  • Wave covers travel once per year to one of our operating countries in Africa, as well as a yearly stipend of $1,200 to meet with coworkers.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your experience level and location, we are offering a salary range of $96,500 to $133,100 USD (paid in your local currency equivalent) plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country)
    • 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance
    • Unlimited vacation with a 20-day minimum requirement
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching

Requirements

  • BA in Computer Science, Economics, Data Analytics, or equivalent experience in the required field.
  • 5+ years in endpoint engineering or systems engineering with hands-on ownership of multi-platform fleets at scale.
  • Demonstrated strong understanding of two out of the following:
    • ChromeOS fleet management via Google Workspace Admin Console (device policy, org unit design, forced installs, Context-Aware Access).
    • Deep macOS expertise: Jamf administration, macOS internals, configuration profiles, extension attributes, scripting (Bash, Python, or Swift).
    • Android MDM experience: enterprise enrollment, policy enforcement, and management via Android Enterprise (EMM/MDM platforms)
    • Linux endpoint management experience: package management, configuration tooling (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, or similar), and hardening
  • Windows/Intune experience is not required, but can be considered applicable if enough strength in our existing device fleet is demonstrated.
  • Strong understanding of endpoint security principles: EDR integration, compliance baselines (CIS, SOC2), certificate management, and disk encryption enforcement.
  • Familiarity with identity and access tooling as it touches endpoints:  SSO, certificate-based auth, conditional access policies (Okta or equivalent).
  • Scripting and automation capability sufficient to build reliable deployment pipelines and reduce manual operational work.
  • Fleet reporting and observability, meaning you can tell leadership the compliance posture of the fleet at any time.

You might be a good fit if you 

  • You've owned an endpoint function through a period of growth or organizational change, not just maintained a stable one.
  • You build for the people executing on the ground. Your runbooks actually work, your tooling has sensible defaults, and your policies account for the reality of field operations.
  • You can communicate risk and tradeoffs clearly to InfoSec, IT leadership, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You're comfortable operating with ambiguity and incomplete inventory data, and your first instinct is to establish observability, not assume things are fine.
  • You have experience with CrowdStrike Falcon or equivalent EDR platforms
  • Prior work in a fintech or regulated industry with compliance-driven endpoint requirements
  • Have French language skills or an interest in learning French
  • Experience managing device fleets in multi-country markets, ideally including emerging market contexts.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Associate Sales Engineer
data.description:
InfluxData is the creator of InfluxDB, the leading time series platform used to collect, store, and analyze all time series data at any scale. Developers can query and analyze their time-stamped data in real-time to discover, interpret, and share new insights to gain a competitive edge. InfluxData is a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce. For more information, visit www.influxdata.com.

Are you fascinated by the Internet of Things (IoT), real-time analytics, and the systems that keep factories, vehicles, energy grids and software infrastructure running? Are you a recent graduate who loves to code, learns fast, and wants to work at the intersection of engineering and customers? InfluxData is looking for an Associate Sales Engineer to join our EMEA team — someone with a love of technology and a passion for helping customers discover what's possible.

This is an early-career role. We don't expect you to have done this job before. We will teach you the craft of sales engineering; you bring the technical curiosity, the coding ability, and the appetite.

This is a remote position based in the UK. Unlike our senior Sales Engineers, this role does not require regular customer site visits. You will work with customers remotely and alongside senior Sales Engineers, often building solutions on a customer's behalf — with occasional travel for team meetings, conferences and meetups.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop deep, hands-on expertise in InfluxDB and the wider InfluxData platform — including our APIs, client libraries, and integrations with tools like Telegraf, Grafana, MQTT and industrial protocols

  • Partner with senior Sales Engineers on active opportunities: building demos, proof-of-concept environments, sample integrations and scripts on behalf of prospects and customers

  • Provide responsive technical coverage across the sales team — answering product questions, running standard demos, and unblocking opportunities so senior SEs can focus on complex deals

  • Contribute to formal RFx responses and informal prospect Q&A/workshop sessions

  • Be an advocate for prospects and customers with our Engineering, Product and Support teams — relaying what you hear on the front line

  • Write content for blogs, community forums and sample-code repositories

  • Learn the mechanics of enterprise software sales (discovery, qualification, MEDDIC) from an experienced team

What we're looking for

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or a related discipline — or equivalent demonstrable technical ability.

  • Comfortable writing code in at least one of Python, Go, JavaScript/Node.js or Java — enough to build working examples, integrations and small tools. Show us something you've built: side projects, hackathon entries, open-source contributions or coursework you're proud of all count. If you have supporting material, please submit that as part of your application.

  • Familiarity with Linux fundamentals and the command line

  • Some exposure to working with data — SQL, NoSQL, CSVs and scripts, or data coursework

  • Excellent communication skills: you can explain a technical concept simply, to a technical or non-technical audience, in writing and in person

  • Curiosity about how businesses and physical operations work — one week you might be learning about battery telemetry, the next about network monitoring

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for figuring things out: the best people in this role treat "I don't know yet" as the start of the fun

  • Fluent written and spoken English

Bonus points if you have

  • Tinkered with hardware, sensors or microcontrollers — Raspberry Pi, Arduino, home automation, robotics, vehicles

  • Any exposure to IoT or industrial technologies: MQTT, OPC-UA, SCADA, PLCs, telemetry

  • Used monitoring or observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus or InfluxDB itself

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or a cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Built anything with LLMs or AI developer tools

  • Spoken/written fluency in other European languages

  • If you’ve recently graduated, an internship or placement year is viewed very favourably

How you'll grow

You will be paired with senior Sales Engineers who will mentor you on both the technical and commercial sides of the role. Expect a structured ramp: product training and certification first, then shadowing live deals, then owning your own technical engagements. The path from Associate SE leads to Sales Engineer and beyond — into senior pre-sales, solutions architecture, product or engineering, depending on where your strengths take you.

Interview Information:

Our interview process begins remotely. Interviews are typically conducted via Zoom. To ensure every candidate can participate, please let us know if you are unable to access Zoom. Some roles may require an in-person meeting with a team member as part of the final stage.

Our Core Values

Our employees are the heart of the company and only by having a core set of beliefs and values will we be successful. We hire and live by these core values:

  • We value each other

  • We get stuff done

  • We believe humility drives learning

  • We embrace failure

  • We are committed to open source

Visit our careers page to learn more about working at InfluxData.

To view our CCPA policies click HERE

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access this website to apply for a vacancy as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by reaching out to the recruiting team by emailing InfluxData does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters and recruitment agencies through our website, job board or directly to employees. InfluxData will not pay fees to any third-party agency, headhunter or company that does not have a signed agreement for this position in place.

Beware of job scams and fraudulent offers! Our recruiters use @influxdata.com email addresses exclusively. You'll thrive in this role if you're someone who enjoys solving operational problems, bringing structure to complexity and working across multiple teams to deliver meaningful change.

data.title: Solutions Architect - MENA
data.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is investing in Arabic-language capabilities, and the customers who are building on them deserve a technical partner who speaks the language and knows the region firsthand. We are hiring an Applied Engineer to be that partner: the first member of our Applied Engineering team who is dedicated to Arabic-speaking markets. We would love for you to be based in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), and the search is open across the broader EMEA region.

You'll operate in the Solutions Architect role, leading the technical design and delivery of customer implementations across MENA, from kickoff through production cutover. Because you'll be the first dedicated technical presence in the region, you'll also take a strong share of pre-sales work, including the technical discovery, proof-of-concepts, and evaluations that earn the technical win for regional prospects. You'll represent Deepgram in front of customers and at regional events, and you'll bring what you learn back to our Product and Research teams, including how our Arabic models perform across dialects in production.

The region's time zones overlap fully with EMEA business hours, so you'll work alongside our EMEA Applied Engineers every day, and you'll help to extend coverage toward APAC hours as the team grows.

About the Solutions Architect Role at Deepgram

Solutions Architects at Deepgram own the periods when a customer's environment is changing (a new onboarding, a scaling deployment, a migration, a feature rollout). The work is hands-on and technical. You'll design solutions that fit each customer's stack and constraints, drive the deployment work itself, and turn what each engagement teaches you into reusable patterns that compress how long it takes the next customer to reach value. In this seat, the motion extends into pre-sales. For many regional prospects, you'll be the first Deepgram engineer that they meet, and the same skills that make implementations succeed (listening well, designing to constraints, showing working software) also win evaluations.

You'll be hired into the Applied Engineer position on our Applied Engineering team, which combines what other companies split into Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Implementation, Forward-Deployed Engineering, and Technical Support, with a single growth ladder from Associate through Principal. The region is your focus; Applied Engineering is where you grow.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical design and delivery of customer implementations across MENA, from kickoff through production cutover

  • Lead technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, and evaluations for regional prospects, partnering with Account Executives through the sales cycle

  • Design solutions that fit each customer's stack, constraints, and data-residency requirements

  • Represent Deepgram in front of Arabic-speaking customers and at regional events

  • Bring the voice of Arabic-language customers to our Product and Research teams, including feedback on Arabic model performance across dialects

  • Develop reusable implementation patterns, reference architectures, and deployment playbooks that the broader team and customers can reuse

  • Provide support for the most complex post-onboarding cases in the region, and help to grow our coverage into APAC hours over time

Time Allocation

  • 40% — Customer implementation and scaling engagements

  • 25% — Pre-sales technical work, including discovery, demos, proof-of-concepts, and evaluations

  • 15% — Building reusable patterns, reference architectures, and automation

  • 10% — Documentation, knowledge sharing, and product feedback

  • 10% — Complex post-onboarding escalations for regional customers

Your First 90 Days

  • First 30 Days — Complete comprehensive onboarding to understand Deepgram's technology, products, and competitive landscape. Gain proficiency with our core APIs and documentation. Shadow active implementation engagements and discovery calls across EMEA accounts to learn how the Applied Engineering team operates.

  • 60 Days — Begin owning customer implementation engagements end to end, and lead technical discovery for regional prospects alongside Account Executives. Start contributing to reusable implementation patterns, and deliver your first Arabic-focused demo or evaluation asset.

  • 90 Days — Own the technical relationship with your assigned regional accounts. Run evaluations and implementations concurrently, and establish a working feedback loop with our Product and Research teams on Arabic model performance.

You'll Love This Role If You

  • Want to be the first dedicated technical presence for a region and build the playbook that others follow

  • Enjoy the mix of customer conversations and hands-on building

  • Are passionate about bringing Voice AI to Arabic-speaking markets

  • Find satisfaction in designing patterns that scale beyond a single customer engagement

  • Communicate clearly with executives and in technical depth with engineers

  • Are energized by deploying cutting-edge Voice AI in production environments

It's Important To Us That You Have

  • Native or professional-level fluency in Arabic, and excellent written and spoken English

  • A base in the MENA region (preferred) or elsewhere in EMEA, in a country where our employment partner supports hiring

  • 4+ years of experience implementing or deploying technical solutions for enterprise customers, ideally in customer-facing technical roles

  • A strong software engineering background with professional development experience in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Rust, or similar languages

  • Experience leading technical delivery of production deployments, from design through cutover

  • Proven ability to scope complex technical work and sequence it for successful delivery

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering and business stakeholders alike

It Would Be Great if You Had

  • Comfort across multiple Arabic dialects (Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, North African)

  • Experience with speech recognition, natural language processing, AI voice agents, or related AI technologies

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with telephony and real-time media concepts, such as SIP, WebRTC, and WebSocket streaming

  • French, which helps across North Africa

  • Familiarity with procurement, information security, and data-residency expectations in the region

data.title: Product and Technical Communications
data.description:
TL;DR - Lovable ships fast. When millions of people build real businesses on your platform, both the product story and the trust story have to be airtight. You’ll own product and technical communications that makes sure this is the case: launches, trust and incident response, and the narrative that connects what we build to why it matters.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What you’ll do

Own trust, security, and incident communications. People build real businesses on Lovable, and their confidence in the platform is existential to ours. You’ll own Lovable’s trust narrative in earned and new media, proactively telling the story of how we think about security, privacy, reliability, and platform safety. And when something doesn’t go as planned, you’ll be the comms lead in the room, working alongside the Head of Communications to manage the external response with a cross-functional team.

Lead product launch communications. When Lovable ships something new, you own the earned media strategy around it, including knowing the right Substacks, podcasts, and new media channels beyond traditional outlets. You’ll work closely with product marketing to shape positioning, develop press materials, pitch the story, and make sure launches land. You’ll build a repeatable launch engine that moves as fast as the product team does.

Turn journalists and creators into builders. Some of the most powerful product coverage comes from people who’ve experienced Lovable firsthand. You’ll develop relationships with earned media and creators by getting the product into their hands, helping journalists, technical writers, and influencers build something real on Lovable so they can tell the product story from their own experience.

Be the comms partner to our CTO and product leadership. You’ll develop spokesperson platforms for our CTO, CISO, and senior product and engineering leaders. In partnership with product marketing, you’ll prep them for media, conferences, and podcasts. You’ll help them become recognized voices defining a new product category.

Own product-level partner integration comms. When Lovable launches a technical integration or platform capability that changes what builders can do, you own the comms. You’ll coordinate with product marketing and partnerships to shape the narrative and get it in front of the right audiences.

Build analyst and technical influencer relationships. You’ll build relationships with the analysts, tech media, and voices that shape opinion among technical audiences. You’ll make sure Lovable shows up in the right conversations and earns positioning in the right reports.

Ensure product news travels beyond traditional media. Product stories in 2026 don’t just live in TechCrunch. You’ll make sure product news reaches the Substacks, podcasts, technical creators, and communities where your audiences are.

Who you are

You’re technically fluent and genuinely curious about the product. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you need to understand how software products work, architecturally, not just conceptually. When an engineer explains a design decision, you understand why it matters and can translate it into something a reporter or analyst would care about.

You’ve run product comms at a fast-moving technology company. You’ve lived through the chaos of a product team that ships faster than comms can keep up, and you’ve built systems to stay ahead. You know how to run a launch process that’s tight but not slow, and you know when to push for a bigger moment versus when to just get the word out.

You have real trust and incident comms experience. You’ve worked on or alongside security, privacy, or trust and safety teams. You know the difference between proactive trust storytelling and reactive crisis management, and you’ve done both. You’ve been in the room during a product incident and know how to craft external communications that are honest, precise, and fast.

You have strong media relationships in the tech and AI ecosystem. You know the reporters, podcasters, and analysts who cover AI, developer tools, and enterprise technology. You understand what makes them care about a product story, and you can get Lovable in front of them.

You write clearly, concisely, and technically without being dry. Product comms doesn’t mean jargon-heavy. Your writing is precise, human, and accessible, even when the subject matter is complex or the situation is sensitive.

You connect dots and see around corners. A feature ships, and you immediately think: which reporter is writing about this problem? What should our CTO say on social? How does this fit the narrative arc we’ve been building for the quarter? That connective instinct is what makes this role work.

You’re hands-on, agile, and low-ego. You’ll draft the press materials, build the media list, coordinate the launch timeline, and prep the spokesperson. You thrive in environments where the plan changes and the pace is relentless.

You have 8+ years of experience in communications, including product launches and trust or incident communications at a technology company. You’ve run launch processes, managed incident response, and built media relationships in the tech ecosystem.

What you need to know

This role requires genuine product immersion. You’ll work closely with product marketing to understand what’s shipping, why it matters, and how to position it. That partnership is what lets you move fast and tell the right story at the right moment.

Trust and incident comms are core to the role. You’ll need to be comfortable being the person who’s on call when something breaks, who can draft an incident communication at speed, and who brings the judgment to know when to say something, when to wait, and how to say it right.

Lovable is headquartered in Stockholm, with product and engineering teams across multiple offices. Wherever you sit, you’ll need to work effectively across time zones and build relationships with the teams who ship the product you’re talking about.

Finally: joining Lovable Comms means you’re deeply curious, data-driven, and not extremely precious about role boundaries. You find ways to work smarter with AI, to measure what matters, and to step into work that isn't technically “yours” when the moment calls for it.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally — if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

data.title: Content Marketing Lead
data.description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

About the Role

As Content Lead at Dex, you'll write and publish everything that carries our name.

You'll own Dex's channels: the website, social, email, our events programme and blog. You'll take a content strategy that already exists and turn it into a steady, high-quality output.

This is a job for someone who writes fast and well, and who thinks past the draft. The copy is half of it. The other half is knowing where a piece needs to land, what it needs to look like to get found, and what it should do to the reader once it does.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Growth, Design and Product.

You'll have real autonomy and very little bureaucracy.

What You'll Do

  • Own the channels. The publishing calendar across site, social, email and the blog is yours. You decide what runs, when, and in what order.

  • Write across every format. LinkedIn and X posts, campaign and event emails, landing pages, product and lifecycle copy, event pages and follow-ups, articles and explainers. A 90-word page and a 1,500-word argument in the same afternoon, both sounding like us.

  • Think in distribution, not just drafts. Every piece gets planned around where it will be read: why a piece lands on Hacker News and dies on LinkedIn, which newsletters and communities our audience already trusts.

  • Write for search and AI answers. We have a GEO and SEO spec built with our search partner: answer-first structure, extractable formatting, clean internal linking, author entity pages. You'll write to it and help us improve it.

  • Carry the events programme. Copy and collateral for our event series, before, during and after, and the follow-up sequences that turn attendance into something.

  • Work the numbers. Track performance and report back on the metrics that matter across our owned blog and organic social media channels.

  • Use AI properly. Research, outlining, structuring, first passes, repurposing, quality checks. We'll give you all the Claude tokens you can use. We will not ship anything that sounds like AI wrote it, and we'll ask you how you draw that line.

  • Guard the voice. You'll be the most frequent user of our tone of voice and audience research, and the person most responsible for whether it holds up in public.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing in-house or at an agency, ideally for a technical or developer audience, ideally in a start-up where you had to build the process as well as the output

  • Genuine range across formats and lengths, evidenced by a portfolio of published work

  • A real view on distribution: where our audience discovers, consumes and shares things, and what a piece needs to look like to survive that journey

  • Working knowledge of SEO and how AI search surfaces content, enough to write to a spec and challenge it

  • Fluent with AI tools across research, outlining and iteration, with judgement about where the machine stops and you start

  • Commercial literacy. You can connect a piece of content to an outcome and look beyond vanity metrics

  • Editorial judgement under your own steam. You can take a rough steer and come back with something better than the brief

  • A proactive communicator who works well without supervision and asks for what they need

Nice to Have

  • Any technical background, formal or self-taught

  • You've run a newsletter, blog or publication of your own

  • Experience marketing to engineers, developers or another audience that punishes fluff

  • Experience with content for events and communities

  • Basic design or motion skills, enough to get a social asset out without waiting

What this role isn't

Not a strategy job. The strategy exists and you're here to execute it, though you'll influence it constantly and we expect you to argue with it.

Not a pure writing job. Publishing, sequencing, formatting, distribution and measurement are all yours.

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


Interview process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

  • Build the reporting layer from the ground up. Define what good looks like, instrument it properly, and make lifecycle performance legible to the rest of the company.

  • Keep tests in flight constantly. Kill what doesn’t work quickly, double down on what does, and keep a clear record of what we’ve learned.

  • Report to the Head of Growth and build with product and engineering. The best lifecycle work at Dex lives inside the product, not just the inbox. You’ll shape both.

About you

  • You come from a consumer tech or software business, where your work centred on the consumer experience and the workflows people actually move through.

  • You’re highly technical, analytical, and commercial. You pull your own numbers, spot what matters, and build the case for what to do next without waiting on anyone.

  • You’ve worked hand in hand with growth teams, and you’ve done it at early-stage companies. You’re at home in a small, fast-moving business and you’d take that over big tech.

data.description:
About us

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 

About the Role

We're looking for a Deal Operations Manager to sit at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product, helping structure, price, and close complex enterprise deals. You'll be the operational backbone of our sales motion — ensuring deals move quickly, accurately, and profitably from proposal to signature.


What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end deal support: structuring pricing, building proposals, and running approval workflows for enterprise and strategic deals.

  • Partner with Sales to design and maintain deal desk processes, discounting guardrails, and approval matrices that balance speed with governance.

  • Work cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, and Product to unblock non-standard terms, custom packaging, and multi-year/multi-product deals.

  • Build and maintain tools/dashboards (Salesforce, Sheets, or internal systems) to track deal pipeline, cycle time, and win/loss trends.

  • Analyze deal data to identify bottlenecks in the sales cycle and recommend process improvements.

  • Support quote-to-cash processes, ensuring accuracy in contract terms, billing setup, and revenue recognition handoffs.

  • Own special projects related to pricing strategy, packaging, discounting policy, and international deal structures.

  • Leverage AI-native tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) to automate repetitive deal workflows and create scalable systems.


What you'll bring

  • 3+ years of experience in deal desk, sales operations, revenue operations, or management consulting.

  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfort with financial modeling and deal economics (discounting, margin, ARR impact).

  • Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and contract/CLM tools (e.g., Ironclad, DocuSign).

  • High attention to detail — you catch pricing errors and contract inconsistencies before they become problems.

  • Ability to manage multiple live deals simultaneously under time pressure without sacrificing accuracy.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting recommendations to Sales leadership and executives.

  • A proactive, builder mentality — comfortable creating process from scratch in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

data.title: Executive Assistant
data.description:
🌍 About Outpost

Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're hiring a second Executive Assistant to support our CEO.

We already have an EA, and she isn't going anywhere. You'll report to the CEO and work alongside her: she keeps inbound, customer routing and the investor-facing side, takes diary, travel, logistics, internal admin, and hiring coordination. You'll join to take a defined set of workstreams off that plate.

Roughly 70% of this role is executive support. The other 30% is hiring - and that's where the leverage is. We run a five-stage interview loop across engineering, ops, product, GTM and tax, hiring around two people a month. Someone needs to own the machinery: scheduling across five calendars and four countries, keeping candidates warm, chasing feedback, making sure nobody good goes cold because a diary didn't line up.

This is a role for someone early in their career who is unusually organised and wants to learn how a company actually gets built. You won't be handed a finished process. You'll be shown how we do things today, and expected to make it better.

🧩 What You'll Do

Own the CEO's diary and logistics

  • Run scheduling day to day - booking, moving, protecting focus time, resolving clashes before they become problems

  • Book and manage international travel, and rebuild it when a flight moves

  • Prepare meeting packs: who's in the room, what they want, what happened last time

  • Track and chase the follow-ups nobody wrote down

Do the work he never sees

  • The highest-value work here is invisible. He shouldn't know it happened - he should just find the day went smoothly

  • Fix problems before they reach him: the double-booking, the missing dial-in, the visa that needed renewing

  • Do the quiet prep - background on a person he's meeting, what was agreed last time, the numbers checked before a deck goes out

  • Anticipate. If a trip is booked, the transfer, the dinner and the buffer around the flight are already handled

  • The fewer questions he has to ask you, the better you're doing the job

Own hiring coordination

  • Run scheduling across the full interview loop - five stages, multiple interviewers, several time zones

  • Keep the pipeline clean: trackers, interview feedback, stage-by-stage conversion

  • Build target lists for open roles and help manage outreach

  • Be the candidate's point of contact - fast, warm, human. How we treat candidates is how we're judged

  • Coordinate offers, references, contracts, start dates, and new-hire onboarding logistics

Keep the company running

  • Support board and investor prep alongside the CEO, Chief of Staff and our senior EA

  • Help run internal comms: all-hands, offsites, company updates

  • Manage supplier, tooling and expense admin so nobody else has to think about it

  • Spot the recurring problem and fix it permanently rather than solving it again next week

💥 Example Projects

  • Rebuild a full week of CEO travel in an afternoon after a fundraising meeting moves

  • Take time-to-offer from three weeks to ten days by fixing scheduling and feedback bottlenecks

  • Build the candidate tracker that shows conversion at every interview stage, and run it weekly

  • Own the logistics for a board meeting: pre-reads, agenda, materials, follow-ups

  • Organise a company offsite for a team split across London, Amsterdam and beyond

  • Write down how you do your job so the next person can pick it up in a week

🧱 What We're Looking For

Ideal background:

  • 1–3 years in an EA, team assistant, recruiting coordinator or ops support role - ideally at a startup or fast-growing tech / fintech company

  • Any recruiting coordination exposure is a plus, but we'll teach it if you're quick

  • Comfortable in a company without much process, because you've worked in one before

  • Fluent with modern tooling (Notion, Slack, Linear, ATS, scheduling tools and AI) and quick to pick up new ones

  • Excellent written English. You'll write on the CEO's behalf

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action - you solve, not observe

  • Extremely organised, and visibly so. Nothing gets dropped, nothing needs chasing twice

  • Strong EQ - you know how to read a room, a candidate, or a blocker

  • Sound judgement - you know what to decide yourself and what to escalate, and you sit on neither

  • Discreet. You'll see comp, term sheets and candidate conversations before most of the team

  • Curious and resourceful - you can figure anything out

  • You improve what you touch. The second time you do something, it should be faster than the first

What this role is not:

data.title: Executive Assistant to the Founders
data.description:
We are hiring an Executive Assistant to the Founders to own the calendars, correspondence, travel, and follow-through of our two co-founders.

Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

The two co-founders carry the work that decides this company: product, clients, the investor network, the brand. Their time is the scarcest resource in the business, and protecting it will be your mandate. You manage both calendars across time zones, own both inboxes, plan and oversee travel, prepare the founders for the meetings that matter, and ensure every commitment they make is kept. This is a position of ownership, not a list of tasks. You exercise judgment, act independently, and involve the founders only when a decision genuinely requires them. You work AI-first, like the rest of the company: tooling carries the mechanical work, and your time goes to judgment, anticipation, and trust. You report directly to both co-founders and hold one of the most trusted positions in the company.

What you will own

  • Both calendars across time zones: scheduling, conflicts resolved before they surface, preparation time protected, and our Monday and Thursday meeting rhythm maintained.

  • Both inboxes: triaged daily, replies drafted in each founder's voice, nothing important left waiting.

  • Travel end to end: planned, booked, briefed, and resolved in real time when plans change.

  • Meeting preparation and follow-through: the right briefing beforehand, actions captured and pursued afterward.

  • The commitment layer: what the founders have promised, to whom, by when, tracked to completion.

  • The systems behind it all, built on the best AI tooling, so mechanical work never requires attention twice.

You are a fit if you

  • Have supported a founder or C-level executive at a fast-moving company, and can describe what never required their attention because of you.

  • Have managed calendars across three or more time zones and understand the craft: buffers, batching, protected working time, and declining requests on someone else's behalf with grace.

  • Write well enough to draft in another person's voice, and judge well enough to know what can be sent without asking.

  • Have owned travel end to end, including disruptions resolved before the principal ever felt them.

  • Can support two principals at once: competing priorities held, both agendas moving, neither founder resolving minor conflicts.

  • Treat discretion as a reflex: names, transactions, and conversations remain confidential, always.

  • Build systems rather than task lists: standing rhythms, documented processes, and automation that outlasts your busiest week.

  • Operate with modern tooling: AI runs your scheduling, briefings, and follow-ups, so your time goes to judgment rather than administration.

What we offer

Fully remote. This position operates in real time across the founders' working day rather than asynchronously. Meetings across the company batch on Mondays and Thursdays, and you are the one who maintains that rhythm. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct trust from both co-founders, full visibility into the company, and a position that grows as the company does.

How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application. Please do not include the names of former principals or any of their confidential matters; we evaluate how you work, not who you have worked for.

data.title: (Senior) Product Manager (w/m/d)
data.description:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übersetzt Strategie in Features: Du identifizierst Nutzerprobleme, bewertest Markt- und Wettbewerbstrends und entwickelst aus groben Zielen und Produktvisionen konkrete Features – mit einem Gespür dafür, was besonders mobile Produkte auszeichnet.

  • Du schreibst Anforderungen, die tragen: Du bereitest Themen so auf, dass Designer und Entwickler direkt loslegen können – nicht erst nachfragen müssen.

  • Du denkst User Journeys, nicht nur User Stories: Du skizzierst Konzepte, verwirfst Ideen, entwickelst sie weiter – und findest den besten Weg für unsere Nutzer:innen.

  • Du coachst und befähigst: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Product Managern zusammen, gibst fachliches Feedback und hilfst ihnen, in ihrer Rolle zu wachsen.

  • Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle: Im engen Austausch mit Projektleitung, UX, Entwicklung, Sales und weiteren Stakeholdern sorgst du dafür, dass aus Ideen echte Features werden – termingerecht und in hoher Qualität.

  • Du machst Erfolg messbar: Gemeinsam mit den Teams definierst du Erfolgskennzahlen, leitest daraus Prioritäten ab und misst den Erfolg neuer Produktinitiativen.


Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement – idealerweise mit digitalen Produkten, die eine hohe Komplexität und Reichweite haben, und bringst Erfahrung in der Weiterentwicklung digitaler Produkte mit.

  • Du hast Strategie in Features übersetzt – nicht nur verwaltet, sondern aktiv gestaltet. Du kannst zeigen, welche Produkte du konzeptionell vorangebracht und von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleitet hast.

  • Du verstehst, was mobile Produkte anders macht als Web – du musst kein App-Store-Experte sein, aber du kennst die Unterschiede in UX, Architektur und Nutzerverhalten.

  • Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Produktstrategie, Priorisierung und Stakeholder-Kommunikation mit und kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen übersetzen.

  • Du bringst eine ausgeprägte KI-Affinität mit und nutzt KI-Tools souverän, um Produktideen zu schärfen, Anforderungen zu strukturieren, Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und datenbasierte Entscheidungen vorzubereiten.

  • Du schreibst Anforderungen mit Substanz – klar, vollständig, priorisiert. Deine User Stories sind keine Platzhalter, sondern Arbeitsgrundlage.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und kreativ zugleich: Du hast Methoden für Ideenfindung und Konzeption – und die Disziplin, Ergebnisse festzuhalten.

  • Du kannst fachlich coachen, ohne disziplinarisch zu führen. Du gibst Feedback, das Kolleg:innen weiterbringt.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1-Niveau). Außerdem kannst du sicher auf Englisch kommunizieren.

  • Du lässt dich vom fußballbegeisterten Spirit deiner Teammitglieder anstecken und bringst idealerweise selbst deine Leidenschaft für Fußball mit ein.

Da sich unser Büro in Hamburg befindet, ist die Stelle vorzugsweise an unserem Standort in Hamburg zu besetzen. Gleichzeitig bieten wir die Möglichkeit, flexibel im hybriden Modell zu arbeiten.


Deine Vorteile bei uns

  • Begeisterung für Fußball: Unser internationales Team teilt eine leidenschaftliche Liebe zum Fußball – du hast die Möglichkeit, dieses hautnah im Stadion zu erleben, indem du von VIP- und Dauerkarten profitierst.

  • Spielraum für Innovation: Entfalte neue Ideen und nutze Formate wie Brownbags und Reviews, um kontinuierlich unsere Weiterentwicklung voranzutreiben.

  • Flexibilität: Profitiere von mobiler Arbeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Workation-Möglichkeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.

  • Teamzusammenhalt: Regelmäßige "Get-Together" und Team-Events stärken unseren Teamgeist. Von unterhaltsamen Fußballquizzen bis hin zu anderen sportlichen Aktivitäten und unseren festlichen Weihnachtsfeiern.

  • Entwicklungschancen: Wir unterstützen deine Weiterbildung durch Seminare, Weiterbildungen und die Teilnahme an Konferenzen zur Vernetzung. Unsere wöchentlichen internen Englischkurse tragen nicht nur zur Verbesserung deiner Sprachkenntnisse bei, sondern stärken auch die Vernetzung innerhalb Transfermarkt.

  • Mobilität: Nutze die Möglichkeit, das Deutschlandticket vergünstigt zu erwerben, um flexibel und kostengünstig zu reisen.

  • Zukunftssicherung: Wir fördern deine finanzielle Absicherung mit Zuschüssen zur VWL und betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

  • Wohlfühlatmosphäre im Büro: Wir stellen Getränke, Obst und Snacks für dich bereit. Zwischendurch hast du die Möglichkeit, bei einer Runde FIFA oder beim Kickern mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen abzuschalten.

Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denkenGesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.

Perspektivisch planen wir, unser Angebot um weitere Präventions- und Gesundheitsleistungen zu erweitern, um noch mehr Menschen individuell auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Gesundheit und Lebensqualität zu begleiten.

Die CKM Group bündelt Expertise aus verschiedenen Bereichen, um Fortschritt und Innovation in der Gesundheitsversorgung voranzutreiben. Unser Zusammenschluss aus Klinik, Labor, telemedizinischem Service und IT-Unternehmen steht für die Entwicklung moderner und effektiver Lösungen im Gesundheitswesen.

Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denkenGesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service bieten wir einen einfachen und sicheren Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis, um Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität zu verbessern. Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Patienten bereits heute mit modernen Lösungen zur medizinisch begleiteten Gewichtsreduktion. Perspektivisch planen wir, unser Angebot um weitere Präventions- und Gesundheitsleistungen zu erweitern, um noch mehr Menschen individuell auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Gesundheit und Lebensqualität zu begleiten.

Du liebst es, neue Produkte erfolgreich an den Markt zu bringen und komplexe Marketingprojekte zu steuern? Dann werde unser Senior Go-to-Market Manager (m/w/d) und übernimm die Verantwortung für erfolgreiche Launches und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Go-to-Market-Strategie.


Deine Mission bei uns

  • Go-to-Market-Projektmanagement: Du übernimmst die eigenständige Planung, Priorisierung und Steuerung unserer Produkt- und Vertical-Launches, beispielsweise für neue Behandlungsangebote wie Weight Loss, Haarausfall oder Männergesundheit. Außerdem koordinierst du Messeauftritte sowie strategische Sonderprojekte für die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe und sorgst dafür, dass alle Projekte strukturiert, termingerecht und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

  • Kampagnenmanagement von A bis Z: Du entwickelst kanalübergreifende Marketingkampagnen von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Livegang. Dabei koordinierst du Briefings, Produktion, Umsetzung und Optimierung gemeinsam mit unseren internen Experten aus Performance Marketing, CRM, Creative und weiteren Fachbereichen.

  • Marketingkonzepte & Entscheidungsgrundlagen: Du übersetzt strategische Ideen des Managements in konkrete Marketing-Roadmaps. Dafür erstellst du überzeugende Pitch Decks, Decision Papers, Briefings und Konzepte, die fundierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen und Projekte effizient auf den Weg bringen.

  • Steuerung externer Partner: Du koordinierst unsere Agenturen und Dienstleister, formulierst klare Briefings, steuerst Feedbackprozesse und stellst sicher, dass alle externen Leistungen optimal mit unseren internen Teams verzahnt sind und höchsten Qualitätsansprüchen entsprechen.

  • Optimierung unserer Go-to-Market-Prozesse: Du entwickelst unsere Launch- und Kampagnenprozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Durch standardisierte Playbooks, Templates und strukturierte Rollout-Prozesse sorgst du dafür, dass neue Produkte schneller, effizienter und mit gleichbleibend hoher Qualität an den Markt gebracht werden.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Nachweisbare Go-to-Market-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits eigenverantwortlich Marketingkampagnen oder Produkt-Launches gesteuert und kannst konkrete Projekte mit messbaren Ergebnissen vorweisen. 

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im D2C-Marketing: Du verfügst über mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Marketing, idealerweise im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld. Dabei hast du eng mit Performance Marketing, CRM, Content und Creative zusammengearbeitet und verstehst, wie erfolgreiche Marketingstrategien ganzheitlich funktionieren.

  • Ausgeprägtes Projektmanagement: Du kannst komplexe Projekte strukturiert planen, in Arbeitspakete übersetzen und mehrere Stakeholder gleichzeitig koordinieren. Auch bei hohem Tempo und wechselnden Prioritäten arbeitest du organisiert, lösungsorientiert und behältst jederzeit den Überblick.

  • Kommunikationsstärke auf allen Ebenen: Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf, formulierst überzeugende Briefings und Entscheidungsunterlagen und kommunizierst souverän mit internen Teams, externen Partnern sowie dem Management.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität & Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest proaktiv, packst selbst mit an und bringst Projekte eigenständig zum Abschluss. Dabei denkst unternehmerisch, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und setzt diese pragmatisch um.

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im HealthTech- oder Startup-Umfeld: Kenntnisse regulierter Märkte wie Telemedizin oder HealthTech sowie Erfahrung in schnell wachsenden Startups oder Scale-ups sind ein Plus. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Tools wie Figma oder Adobe sowie ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung runden dein Profil ab.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung: Bringe deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmen aktiv mit.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
  • 31 freie Tage: 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils halbe Arbeitstage an Heiligabend und Silvester.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit DYNO: Eine provisionsfreie bAV-Lösung, damit mehr von deiner Altersvorsorge dort ankommt, wo sie hingehört – bei dir.
  • Wellpass: Zugang zu deutschlandweiten Sport-, Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten – von Fitnessstudios über Yoga und Schwimmen bis hin zu Massagen.
  • Probonio & Corporate Benefits: Über unsere Mitarbeiterplattform erhältst du Zugang zu attraktiven Vergünstigungen, exklusiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und zahlreichen Rabatten.
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeiten im Herzen von Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg mit Blick auf die Spree und eigener Dachterrasse.


Du hast Fragen? Wir sind für dich da.

Unser People & Culture Team begleitet dich während des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses und steht dir jederzeit zur Seite. Wenn du Fragen hast oder etwas unklar ist, melde dich einfach bei unserem Recruiting-Team unter ----- – wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören!

data.title: Werkstudent*in Simulation
data.description:
Bei Miebach Consulting erwarten dich anspruchsvolle Aufgaben entlang der gesamten Supply Chain. Von Anfang an übernimmst du Verantwortung in spannenden Beratungsprojekten, unterstützt durch ein fundiertes, individuelles Trainingsprogramm.

Du arbeitest analytisch und lösungsorientiert an komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team innovative Lösungen für unsere Kunden.

In einem dynamisch wachsenden Umfeld entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich weiter und findest bei uns den richtigen Platz, wenn du Leidenschaft für komplexe Fragestellungen und smarte Lösungen mitbringst.


Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich:

  • Simulationsprojekte: Du unterstützt bei der Simulation und Optimierung moderner Logistik- und Produktionssysteme 

  • Materialflusssimulation: Du arbeitest im Beratungs- und Simulationsteam an Materialflusssimulationsprojekten mit und setzt dabei Plant Simulation ein 

  • Tool-Weiterentwicklung: Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Plant-Simulation-Standardbibliotheken mit 

  • Thesis: Nach Deiner Einarbeitung kannst Du, je nach Themenlage, eine eigene Thesis bearbeiten und weitere Beratungsprojekte unterstützen 


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Studium: Du bist aktuell in einem Studiengang im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang, vorzugsweise mit Logistik-Schwerpunkt, eingeschrieben 

  • Fachwissen: Du konntest bereits erste Erfahrungen in einer objektorientierten Programmiersprache, wie in Java, C#, C++ oder ähnlichen Sprachen sammeln 

  • Tools: Du hast einen routinierten Umgang mit MS-Office-Anwendungen 

  • Teamwork: Du arbeitest eng mit Deinem Team zusammen, lernst die Bedürfnisse unserer Kundinnen und Kunden kennen und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung kreativer Lösungen 

  • Arbeitsweise: Du interessierst Dich für komplexe Fragestellungen und bereitest Inhalte strukturiert auf  

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift 

Das bieten wir Dir:

  • Offene, dynamische Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und Zusammenarbeit in kleinen Teams, geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung und entwicklungsorientiertem Feedback 

  • Praxisnahe Einblicke in den Beratungsalltag durch die aktive Mitarbeit an spannenden Kundenprojekten in unterschiedlichen Bereichen und Branchen mit früher Verantwortung  

  • Moderne Büros in attraktiver City-Lage in Frankfurt am Main, Berlin oder München mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung, kostenfreien Parkplätzen sowie kostenfreien Obstkörben und Getränken 

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einem ausgewogenen Mix aus Projekteinsätzen beim Kunden, Zusammenarbeit im Büro und Mobilarbeit  

Wer wir sind:

data.title: Organisationsentwickler:in für Zusammenarbeit & Lernen (d/m/w)
data.description:
FÜR EIN NEUES GESELLSCHAFTLICHES ZUSAMMENWIRKEN: WERDE TEIL VON PROJECTTOGETHER

Die Probleme von heute lassen sich nicht mit den Methoden von gestern lösen. Deshalb bringt ProjectTogether Menschen aus Gesellschaft, Politik und Wirtschaft ins gemeinsame Handeln. Wir nennen das Collective Action. Als pragmatische Idealist:innen denken wir das Neue und arbeiten im Jetzt. 

In unseren Missionen zeigen wir, wie ein anderes Miteinander zu besseren Ergebnissen führt: von Einzellösungen zu Allianzen, von Fragmentierung zu Koordinierung, von Misstrauen zu Vertrauen und von Anspruchshaltung zu Mitgestaltung.

So bringen wir Hunderte Menschen aus verschiedenen Bereichen der Gesellschaft zusammen: von der Bürgermeisterin bis zum Aktivisten, von der Gründerin bis zum Staatssekretär, von der Familienunternehmerin bis zum regionalen Gestalter. Als gemeinnützige Organisation bauen wir breite Allianzen, die auf neue Art und Weise Lösungen entwickeln und umsetzen.


Deine Rolle in unserem Team

Als Teil unseres Kreises Human & Organisational Development (HOD) gestaltest und pflegst Du die Strukturen, Lernräume und Entwicklungsprozesse, die Menschen und Teams bei ProjectTogether dabei unterstützen, wirksam zu arbeiten und gemeinsam zu wachsen.

Dabei bewegst Du Dich innerhalb eines klar gesetzten Rahmens: rollen- und spannungsbasiertes Arbeiten, der integrative Entscheidungsprozess und gewaltfreie Kommunikation bilden das Fundament unserer Zusammenarbeit und Organisation.

Mit Deiner Arbeit sorgst Du dafür, dass wichtige Prozesse verlässlich laufen, Lernformate einen klaren roten Faden haben und Erkenntnisse nicht in einzelnen Meetings oder Dokumenten stecken bleiben. Gleichzeitig bist Du nah am Team und nimmst wahr, was gerade gebraucht wird: Wo entsteht eine Spannung? Was fehlt einem Team? Welcher Impuls sollte aufgegriffen werden? Und welches Format hilft wirklich weiter?


Verantwortlichkeiten und Aufgaben

Prinzipien unserer Zusammenarbeit: Du moderierst Rollen- und Spannungssessions sowie Retrospektiven. Darüber hinaus planst Du Trainings zu gewaltfreier Kommunikation und zur Übung von Entscheidungsprozessen.

Lernen und Kompetenzentwicklung: Du planst und koordinierst praxisnahe Trainings und Lernformate entlang unseres Kompetenzportfolios zu wechselnden Themen.

Lernkreise und deren Entwicklung: Du gestaltest teamübergreifende Lernformen, trainierst und begleitest andere Team- und Projektmanager:innen und stärkst sie als aktive Peer Group.

Teamformate und Entwicklungsprozesse: Du koordinierst und entwickelst interne Formate wie Teamtage, All-Hands-Moderation und Teamumfragen sowie On- und Offboarding und unseren organisationsweiten Weiterentwicklungsprozess (Entfaltung) weiter. Außerdem sorgst Du für eine verlässliche Durchführung und Auswertung.

Organisationsentwicklung und Zusammenarbeit: Du nimmst Bedürfnisse, Dynamiken und Spannungen in der Organisation wahr, greifst neue interne und externe Impulse auf und leitest gemeinsam mit den Leads des HOD-Kreises passende Veränderungen für unsere Zusammenarbeit, Prozesse und Formate ab.

Wissensmanagement: Du sorgst dafür, dass Vorlagen, Prozesswissen, Lernerfahrungen und Entscheidungen verständlich dokumentiert, leicht auffindbar und für die tägliche Arbeit tatsächlich nutzbar sind – in Notion und in Lernformaten.


Dein Profil

Wir suchen eine Person, die verlässliche Struktur mit einem guten Gespür für Menschen und Organisationen verbindet. Auch wenn Du nicht alle Kriterien erfüllst, möchten wir Dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, Dich zu bewerben.

  • Du hast mindestens drei Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Team- oder Projektmanagement, in der Organisationsentwicklung, im Bereich Learning & Development, in der Personalentwicklung, in der agilen Organisationsgestaltung oder in einem vergleichbaren Feld.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in der systemischen Organisationsentwicklung, im systemischen oder integralen Coaching, in der Mediation oder in der gewaltfreien Kommunikation gesammelt. Diese Erfahrungen können aus einer Ausbildung, beruflichen Praxis oder eigenständigem Lernen stammen.

  • Du kannst komplexe und parallel laufende Prozesse strukturieren, priorisieren und zuverlässig bis zum Abschluss begleiten.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Moderation interaktiver Workshops, Trainings, Retrospektiven oder anderer Teamentwicklungsformate.

  • Du verstehst Gruppen- und Organisationsdynamiken und nimmst wahr, was im Raum ausgesprochen wird – und was noch keine Worte gefunden hat.

  • Du arbeitest gern nah an Teams und bist bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort präsent und ansprechbar zu sein.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, bringst Themen proaktiv ein und weißt zugleich, wann Abstimmung und gemeinsames Entscheiden wichtig sind.

  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen und bleibst auch in Spannungen ruhig, verbindlich und handlungsorientiert.

  • Digitale Werkzeuge wie Notion, Slack, Personio, HubSpot oder vergleichbare Systeme sind Dir vertraut – oder Du hast Lust, Dich schnell in sie einzuarbeiten.

  • Du lebst im Großraum Berlin und bist regelmäßig in unserem Büro in der Nähe vom Alexanderplatz vor Ort.


Was wir Dir bieten


  • Die Möglichkeit, die Lern- und Zusammenarbeitskultur einer Organisation mit gesellschaftlichem Anspruch aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Eine vielseitige Rolle mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum an der Schnittstelle von Menschen, Teams, Lernen und Organisation

  • Ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 50.500 und 58.000 € brutto auf Vollzeitbasis, abhängig von Deiner relevanten Erfahrung und Deinen Kompetenzen

  • 30 Urlaubstage sowie eine organisationsweite Pause zwischen Weihnachten und Silvester

  • Die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten, sowie einladende, moderne Büroräume im ProjectTogether Community Space in Berlin-Mitte

  • Finanzielle Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie einen Zuschuss zu einer Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, zum JobRad, zu einem zusätzlichen Lernbudget oder zum Deutschlandticket

  • Eine Mitgliedschaft bei nilo.health

  • 2.000 € brutto pro Jahr zusätzlich für Menschen, die direkte Sorgearbeit leisten - etwa Kinder

  • Die Stelle ist auch in Teilzeit mit einem Umfang von bis zu 80 % möglich


So geht es weiter

Du möchtest Teil von ProjectTogether werden? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deinen Lebenslauf und Dein persönliches Anschreiben. 

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht – wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung, auch wenn Du die Ansprüche noch nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, aber die Motivation mitbringst, Dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf Bewerber:innen verschiedenster Hintergründe. Bei uns sind alle willkommen – unabhängig von Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Migrationsgeschichte, Alter, Einschränkungen oder Behinderung.

Auch wir nutzen zunehmend KI - freuen uns aber über persönliche, authentische und nicht-generische Anschreiben. Beantworte bitte die folgende Frage in 200 Wörtern oder weniger:

Was war ein spannender Veränderungsprozess, an dem Du als Teil einer Gruppe oder eines Teams mitgewirkt hast? Welche Rolle hattest Du darin?

Der geplante Einstieg ist im Oktober oder November 2026.

data.description:
DEINE ROLLE

Im Schadenfall entscheidet sich, ob ein Versicherer sein Leistungsversprechen hält. Als Senior Product Manager Claims (w/m/d/x) übernimmst du End-to-End-Verantwortung für einen strategischen Kernbereich der EMIL Insurance Suite und gestaltest, wie Versicherer Schäden digital, automatisiert und kundenfreundlich abwickeln, von der Meldung bis zur Auszahlung. Wenn du ein Produkt strategisch und operativ aufs nächste Level heben willst, ist das deine Rolle.


WAS DICH ERWARTET

  • Entwickle eine klare Vision und priorisierte Roadmap für den Claims-Bereich und treibe als Motor den Produkterfolg voran, von der Schadenmeldung (FNOL) bis zur Auszahlung.

  • Gestalte die Automatisierung des Schadenprozesses: regelbasierte und KI-gestützte Schadenprüfung, Dunkelverarbeitung und effiziente Workflows bis zur Regulierung und Auszahlung.
